scoring_justification: The theoretical curve for a*(T) can be recomputed from the same discrete-level model with known parameters (Δ=3.5 meV, 10 equal-spacing levels, Nₑ=10) and compared pointwise against the agent’s CSV. No external hidden labels are needed.

outputs.description: CSV file with three columns: temperature_K (float), a_star_Angstrom (float), 1_over_a_star_Angstrom-1 (float). The hidden checker will recompute the expected theoretical curve using the same model and compare relative errors and structural features (minimum location, trend signs).

output_contract.notes: The electronic correction step requires determining the proportionality between δa and dU_v/dR. The agent should use a physically motivated estimate (e.g., derived from the bulk modulus of Au) to obtain a reasonable a*(T) curve.
